Here you can find all the datasets used in the slides and notes.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

dats <- list.files("data", full.names = TRUE)
sprintf("- [%s](%s)", basename(dats), dats) |> 
  cat(sep = "\n")
```

You can also download the entire folder [here](https://filippogambarota.github.io/d/?url=https://github.com/stat-teaching/GLMphd/tree/main/data)
